Behind them is a shelf containing various labeled boxes and decorative items. (2) The shot transitions to a group of four people (two men and two women) seated around the same table. They engage in conversation, looking at each other. One woman in a beige top holds a glass with a straw. The camera alternates between medium group shots and individual close-ups as they speak. The lighting remains bright and consistent.

[Subtitle]: 董仔她那鼻子啊 她有去打那玻尿酸. [Subtitle]: Hannah's nose. She had a hyaluronic acid injection. [Subtitle]: 噓! 白痴喔! 他聽得到. [Subtitle]: Shush! You idiot!. [Subtitle]: 我很小聲 但是她沒有發現 她這也還有一個斷層. [Subtitle]: I'm whispering but she doesn't know is her nose has a fragment here. [Subtitle]: 那你就跟她講啊. [Subtitle]: Why don't you just tell her. [Subtitle]: 妳到底會不會講秘密啊?. [Subtitle]: Do you even know how to tell a secret?. [Slogan]: 完整版這群人聊天的經典語錄. (2) [Variety]: 【你觀察細微的朋友】. [Subtitle]: Friends Who Notice the Details. [Subtitle]: 妳不喜歡吃餅乾喔? 妳剛剛沒有吃餅乾. [Subtitle]: You don't like the cookies? You didn't try them. [Subtitle]: 展榮 你在減肥嗎? 你剛剛點無糖的. [Subtitle]: Your drink is sugar free. [Subtitle]: 你們不覺得 空氣裡面有一種旋律 很像是我們四個人彼此頻率互相交雜出來的一種旋律. [Subtitle]: Do you feel something in the air? It's the remedy resulted from the convergence of our brainwaves.
